title: In vitro generation of long-lived human Plasma Cells II
description: Gene expression profiling of B-cells from a model differentiation series: from Naïve B-cells, through a proliferative plasmablast stage to long-lived antibody secreting plasma cells. Overall design: B-cells were isolated from the peripheral blood of three adult donors and differentiated in vitro (see individual samples for culture conditions)

samples.title: Day41PC_DonorC
attributes: CD138+ Plasma cells sorted on CD138 and 7-AAD, generated in the upper compartment of a transwell system after 28 days of IL-6, IFN-α and supplemented media, with M2-10B4 in the lower compartment.
